site.title: {project} - Decentralisado fayl partaisman
site.description: {project} a wan peer-to-peer program fu fayl partaisman, bow tapu modern decentralisado teknologia.
site.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer fayl partaisman bow tapu modern decentralisado teknologia. No wan sentral server. No wan enkri pwenti fu mankeri.

hero.subtitle: Nyun-generasi peer-to-peer fayl partaisman
hero.description: Bow tapu modern decentralisado teknologia. No wan sentral server. No wan enkri pwenti fu mankeri.

about.title: Abra
about.intro: {project} a wan nyun-generasi platfom fu peer-to-peer fayl partaisman, bow tapu modern decentralisado teknologia. A e poti makandra wan makriki interface nanga wan dorodoro decentralisado architectura, e meki seyker dati a fayl partaisman safu en bétro sondro fu abi wan sentral autoriteit. A projekt disi a open source, puru ondro a {license}.

decentralized.title: Dorodoro decentralisado netwerk
decentralized.description: No wan sentral server, no wan enkri pwenti fu mankeri. Den gebroykiman e feni en hari kon contenti dirèktilek fu trawan, sondro fu hari tapu wan sentral indeks, suku enjin noso database.

accessControl.title: Fayni kontrol fu aksès
accessControl.description: Iniwan e man bow en eigi netwerk nanga en eigi reglamenti, fu noting. Inisey ibri netwerk, den rol fu gebroykiman e seti: eyenari, administrator, editor, moderator, en folowman. Yu abi fayni kontrol abra suma e man pubrisèr, modere, en hari kon contenti.

ui.title: Hey kwaliteit interface
ui.description: Wan krin en yepi-yepi media center interface, meki gi desktop, TV, en mobyl platfom. Makriki navigasyon nanga keyboard, muso, gamepad, noso afsantswèl. Sabiman gebroykiman e man waka a program leki wan ede-lasi server tru a kòmandi-lèyn interface.

dataFormat.title: Suma-leysiman fasi data
dataFormat.description: A LISH data fasi e bow tapu JSON, e meki en makriki fu meki, leysi, en frustan. Hari kon yu contenti nanga krin en transparant metadata san iniwan e man froeke.

security.title: Privatsi en seyker
security.description: Ala den peer-to-peer komunikasyon e kripti, e meki seyker dati yu data e tan privat na ini transit. Den gebroykiman e man kibri baka wan VPN gi ekstra anonimiteit. {project} e respektir yu privatsi fu konstruksyon.

crossPlatform.title: Multi-platfom
crossPlatform.description: A program de gi Windows, Linux, en macOS. Gebroyki en tapu iniwan platfom yu wani.

download.title: Hari kon
download.description: Teki {project} gi yu platfom. Ala harikon e fu noting en open source.
